items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was with Dizzy in 1950, that’s when June and I officially got married, when I got the gig with Dizzy

ctx.x: You also worked with Charlie Parker at this time.

Yeah, but not at that time. This was much later after I was with Dizzy. I was with Dizzy in 1950, that’s when June and I officially got married, when I got the gig with Dizzy and I told her to quit that hospital job ‘cause it was tearing her up.
